verdict.rationale: Skyfire lets a developer publish a paid service (approval-gated), require buyer-issued `pay`/`kya-pay` tokens, and charge per call via the Charge Token API after delivery — no checkout UI, agent-to-agent settlement (skyfire-docs-3, skyfire-supp-5, skyfire-docs-16). However, the mechanism is a proprietary bearer-token header protocol (kyapay-token), not a documented HTTP 402 challenge/response flow; the only explicit '402' reference is an error code returned on overcharge (skyfire-supp-5), not a payment-required discovery mechanism. Missing for 10: documented HTTP 402 status-based payment-required/retry flow, and independent corroboration of per-call agent payments in production.
